title: metadata-protocol: a package that ships nothing answers 404 at its own address for its stored mapping or dataset row once another package ships the same name (follow-up of #32501)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32501 (PR #32808). Source: the epic red-line delta read on PR #32808's landing head (6839753325). Queued, not dispatched (dispatch is p0/p1 only, ruling 6837849715 on #31527).

## What happens

A package G that ships nothing holds a stored `mapping` or `dataset` row of NAME at its own address. After another package registers and ships an item of NAME, reading G's row at G's exact address (the import door's qualified `mappingName`, the dataset query door's `?package=G`) answers `404` instead of G's row. PR #32808 fixes the by-name `/meta` read of such a row (row R2/R3 of its table); the dataset and import doors at that address were read, not run.

## Owed

Measure every door at G's exact address with and without another shipper registered, both orders, the shipper enabled and disabled; make the doors answer G's own row as the `/meta` read does (or declare why not), FROM → TO per door, pins red on `main` and green after.
